thread:
kai: heads-up — nightly eval flagged a big uptick in hallucinations for the new open-variant when using the FP8 precision profile.

eval-bot: nightly-run 2026-02-18 03:12:01 UTC — model=open-variant-v1, profile=fp8-compact, failures=12, fail_rate=7.4% (baseline 1.1%)

anya: yikes. which prompt set?

kai: mainly qa-pairs-longform and code-extraction tests. examples below. seems skewed toward multi-hop factuals and long context windows (>1024).

oliver: can you paste a couple of failing generations?

kai: sure. short excerpt: 
```
PROMPT: Who invented the micro-processor and in what year?
GOLD: Ted Hoff (Intel) / 1971
FP32 OUTPUT: The microprocessor was developed by Ted Hoff at Intel in 1971.
FP8 OUTPUT: The microprocessor was created by a committee in 1983, and later adopted by IBM.
```

maria: interesting — FP8 output adds incorrect entity and year. any sign of truncated logits or token saturation in runtime logs?

kai: I grabbed the runtime slice. see kv-cache warnings and a lot of `scale_rescale` saturations right before onset.

```
[2026-02-18 02:59:12] WARN runtime: kv_cache_miss=0.02 rescale_op=scale_rescale overflow_count=31
[2026-02-18 02:59:12] ERROR quant: per_channel_scale_clip triggered for layer=attn.qkv scale=0.00012 clipped_to=0.00008
[2026-02-18 02:59:12] DEBUG sampler: top_p=0.95 temp=0.7 tokens_emitted=120
```

anya: that per_channel clipping smells like calibration mismatch. Did the calibration set include these longform QA prompts?

kai: nope — calib used short completion set (avg len 50) and mostly conversational samples.

oliver: so distribution shift. two immediate mitigations: 1) rollback to last-good fp8 profile (or FP16), 2) rerun calibration with representative longform set and maybe use asymmetric quant or widen scale clamp.

maria: can we toggle fallback at routing layer to prefer fp16 for requests with >1k tokens? quick config snippet I can push: 
```json
{"route": "/api/generate", "rules": [{"if": "input_tokens>1024","preferred_profile":"fp16"},{"else":"fp8-compact"}]}
```

kai: +1 for immediate fallback. I'll open a PR for a recalibration job that includes qa-pairs-longform and code-extract.

anya: also want to capture eval diffs per prompt so we can see which clusters of prompts break — tag them as `hallucination_fp8_longform` in the eval DB.

kai: noted. action items: rollback routing fallback (maria), new calibration job + dataset (kai), eval-tagging and dashboard drilldown (anya). I'll create the tracking ticket.

eval-bot: ticket created — #INFER-1428: "FP8 longform hallucination surge — rollback + recalib" — assignees: kai, maria, anya

oliver: timeline? we should keep hosted customers notified if SLA-sensitive.

maria: can do rollback in 30m, push fallback rule to production. I'll post in #incidents if we flip routing for hosted.

kai: thanks. I'll attach a small sample set and expected outputs to the ticket.

anya: once recalib runs, let's run targeted A/B eval on the 200 failing prompts and compare exact-match / factual recall metrics. planning note: calibrate with MSE+KL loss mix and try per-channel asymmetric scales first. :microscope:

oliver: SGTM. please ping once rollback is live so I can re-run the nightly with fallback and confirm rates drop.

kai: will do.
